<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Subscription" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/subscription">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Subscription" name="Subscription Lifecycle" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Subscription">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_SignUp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterInformation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitCancellation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignAccess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RunBilling</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ActiveMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendNotification</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CancelDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Support" name="Support Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessCancellation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TermsDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyCharge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TermsMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeactivateSubscription</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SettleBalance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_SubscriptionClosed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SignUp" name="Customer signs up for subscription">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SignUpToEnterInfo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterInformation" name="Enter personal and payment information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SignUpToEnterInfo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterInfoToGenerate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateAccount" name="Generate account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterInfoToGenerate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GenerateToAssign</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AssignAccess" name="Assign access">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GenerateToAssign</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AssignToBilling</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RunBilling" name="Trigger automated billing cycle">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AssignToBilling</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BillingToActiveMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ActiveMerge" name="Subscription active">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BillingToActiveMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotificationToActiveMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ActiveMergeToCancelDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CancelDecision" name="Customer decides to cancel?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ActiveMergeToCancelDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CancelDecisionNo</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CancelDecisionYes</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendNotification" name="Send update, enhancement or renewal notification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CancelDecisionNo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotificationToActiveMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitCancellation" name="Submit cancellation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CancelDecisionYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubmitToProcessCancellation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProcessCancellation" name="Process cancellation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubmitToProcessCancellation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ProcessCancellationToTerms</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TermsDecision" name="Depending on the terms">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ProcessCancellationToTerms</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TermsToRefund</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TermsToCharge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyRefund" name="Apply refund">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TermsToRefund</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RefundToTermsMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyCharge" name="Apply charge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TermsToCharge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ChargeToTermsMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TermsMerge" name="Refund or charge settled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RefundToTermsMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChargeToTermsMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TermsMergeToDeactivate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DeactivateSubscription" name="Deactivate subscription">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TermsMergeToDeactivate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DeactivateToSettle</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SettleBalance" name="Settle final account balance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DeactivateToSettle</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SettleToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SubscriptionClosed" name="Subscription concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SettleToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SignUpToEnterInfo" sourceRef="StartEvent_SignUp" targetRef="Task_EnterInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterInfoToGenerate" sourceRef="Task_EnterInformation" targetRef="Task_GenerateAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GenerateToAssign" sourceRef="Task_GenerateAccount" targetRef="Task_AssignAccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssignToBilling" sourceRef="Task_AssignAccess" targetRef="Task_RunBilling"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingToActiveMerge" sourceRef="Task_RunBilling" targetRef="Gateway_ActiveMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotificationToActiveMerge" sourceRef="Task_SendNotification" targetRef="Gateway_ActiveMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ActiveMergeToCancelDecision" sourceRef="Gateway_ActiveMerge" targetRef="Gateway_CancelDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CancelDecisionNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CancelDecision" targetRef="Task_SendNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CancelDecisionYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CancelDecision" targetRef="Task_SubmitCancellation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitToProcessCancellation" sourceRef="Task_SubmitCancellation" targetRef="Task_ProcessCancellation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProcessCancellationToTerms" sourceRef="Task_ProcessCancellation" targetRef="Gateway_TermsDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TermsToRefund" name="Refund due" sourceRef="Gateway_TermsDecision" targetRef="Task_ApplyRefund"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TermsToCharge" name="Charge due" sourceRef="Gateway_TermsDecision" targetRef="Task_ApplyCharge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundToTermsMerge" sourceRef="Task_ApplyRefund" targetRef="Gateway_TermsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChargeToTermsMerge" sourceRef="Task_ApplyCharge" targetRef="Gateway_TermsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TermsMergeToDeactivate" sourceRef="Gateway_TermsMerge" targetRef="Task_DeactivateSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeactivateToSettle" sourceRef="Task_DeactivateSubscription" targetRef="Task_SettleBalance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SettleToEnd" sourceRef="Task_SettleBalance" targetRef="EndEvent_SubscriptionClosed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CancelDecisionNo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateToEnhancement</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendEnhancement" name="Send product enhancement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateToEnhancement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnhancementToRenewal</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRenewal" name="Send renewal notification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnhancementToRenewal</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RenewalToActiveMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitCancellation" name="Submit cancellation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CancelDecisionYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubmitToProcessCancellation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProcessCancellation" name="Process cancellation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubmitToProcessCancellation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ProcessCancellationToTerms</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TermsDecision" name="Depending on the terms">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ProcessCancellationToTerms</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TermsToRefund</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TermsToCharge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyRefund" name="Apply refund">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TermsToRefund</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RefundToTermsMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyCharge" name="Apply charge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TermsToCharge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ChargeToTermsMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TermsMerge" name="Refund or charge settled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RefundToTermsMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChargeToTermsMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TermsMergeToDeactivate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DeactivateSubscription" name="Deactivate subscription">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TermsMergeToDeactivate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DeactivateToSettle</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SettleBalance" name="Settle final account balance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DeactivateToSettle</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SettleToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SubscriptionClosed" name="Subscription concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SettleToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToSignUp" sourceRef="StartEvent_SignUp" targetRef="Task_SignUp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SignUpToPersonalInfo" sourceRef="Task_SignUp" targetRef="Task_EnterPersonalInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PersonalInfoToPaymentInfo" sourceRef="Task_EnterPersonalInfo" targetRef="Task_EnterPaymentInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentInfoToGenerate" sourceRef="Task_EnterPaymentInfo" targetRef="Task_GenerateAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GenerateToAssign" sourceRef="Task_GenerateAccount" targetRef="Task_AssignAccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssignToBilling" sourceRef="Task_AssignAccess" targetRef="Task_RunBilling"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingToActiveMerge" sourceRef="Task_RunBilling" targetRef="Gateway_ActiveMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RenewalToActiveMerge" sourceRef="Task_SendRenewal" targetRef="Gateway_ActiveMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ActiveMergeToCancelDecision" sourceRef="Gateway_ActiveMerge" targetRef="Gateway_CancelDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CancelDecisionNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CancelDecision" targetRef="Task_SendUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CancelDecisionYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CancelDecision" targetRef="Task_SubmitCancellation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateToEnhancement" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdate" targetRef="Task_SendEnhancement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnhancementToRenewal" sourceRef="Task_SendEnhancement" targetRef="Task_SendRenewal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitToProcessCancellation" sourceRef="Task_SubmitCancellation" targetRef="Task_ProcessCancellation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProcessCancellationToTerms" sourceRef="Task_ProcessCancellation" targetRef="Gateway_TermsDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TermsToRefund" name="Refund due" sourceRef="Gateway_TermsDecision" targetRef="Task_ApplyRefund"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TermsToCharge" name="Charge due" sourceRef="Gateway_TermsDecision" targetRef="Task_ApplyCharge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundToTermsMerge" sourceRef="Task_ApplyRefund" targetRef="Gateway_TermsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChargeToTermsMerge" sourceRef="Task_ApplyCharge" targetRef="Gateway_TermsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TermsMergeToDeactivate" sourceRef="Gateway_TermsMerge" targetRef="Task_DeactivateSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeactivateToSettle" sourceRef="Task_DeactivateSubscription" targetRef="Task_SettleBalance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SettleToEnd" sourceRef="Task_SettleBalance" targetRef="EndEvent_SubscriptionClosed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Subscription" name="Subscription Lifecycle" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Subscription">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_SignUp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="System">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_LoopMerge" name="Subscription period">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BillingToLoopMerge</bpmn:incoming>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LoopMergeToSendUpdate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendUpdate" name="Send regular update">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LoopMergeToSendUpdate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendUpdateToEnhancement</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendEnhancement" name="Send product enhancement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendUpdateToEnhancement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnhancementToRenewal</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRenewalNotification" name="Send renewal notification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnhancementToRenewal</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RenewalToCancelDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CancelDecision" name="Customer decides to cancel?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RenewalToCancelDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CancelNoToLoopMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CancelYesToSubmit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitCancellation" name="Submit cancellation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CancelYesToSubmit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubmitToProcessCancellation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProcessCancellation" name="Process cancellation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubmitToProcessCancellation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ProcessCancellationToTerms</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TermsDecision" name="Depending on the terms">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ProcessCancellationToTerms</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TermsToRefund</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TermsToCharge</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyRefund" name="Apply refund">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TermsToRefund</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RefundToTermsMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyCharge" name="Apply charge">

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TermsMerge" name="Refund or charge settled">

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DeactivateSubscription" name="Deactivate subscription">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DeactivateToSettle</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SettleBalance" name="Settle final account balance">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SettleToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SubscriptionClosed" name="Subscription deactivated and balance settled">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToSignUp" sourceRef="StartEvent_SignUp" targetRef="Task_SignUp"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitToProcessCancellation" sourceRef="Task_SubmitCancellation" targetRef="Task_ProcessCancellation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProcessCancellationToTerms" sourceRef="Task_ProcessCancellation" targetRef="Gateway_TermsDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TermsToRefund" name="Refund due" sourceRef="Gateway_TermsDecision" targetRef="Task_ApplyRefund"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TermsToCharge" name="Charge due" sourceRef="Gateway_TermsDecision" targetRef="Task_ApplyCharge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundToTermsMerge" sourceRef="Task_ApplyRefund" targetRef="Gateway_TermsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChargeToTermsMerge" sourceRef="Task_ApplyCharge" targetRef="Gateway_TermsMerge"/>

rules.instruction: When the description says the process begins with an action performed by an actor, such as a person signing up, and that action is itself described as work the actor performs: Model a plain start event with no incoming flow, followed by a task that represents the performed action. Do not place the performed action on the start event itself. The task then leads into the subsequent steps.
rules.situation: the description says the process begins with an action performed by an actor, such as a person signing up, and that action is itself described as work the actor performs

rules.instruction: When the description states one action in a sentence whose object is a list of distinct items joined by commas or 'and' (for example, an actor selects several things, or provides several kinds of information, in one phrase): Model each distinct item in that list as its own activity, in the order the description gives them, instead of merging the list into a single activity. Keep the activities in sequence and do not add gateways unless the description states a choice or concurrency.
rules.situation: the description states, in one phrase, that one party receives or is sent several distinct kinds of communications joined by commas and 'or' (for example, a list of kinds with 'or' before the last item), and does not state a choice between them

rules.instruction: When the description opens with an actor performing an action that initiates the process, such as submitting, reporting or requesting something, and that action is itself described as work done by the actor: Model a start event for the process trigger, then a task for the initiating action performed by that actor, and connect the start event to that task with a sequence flow. Do not make the initiating action itself the start event; the start event marks only the occurrence that begins the process.
rules.situation: the description says the process begins when an actor performs an action that is itself a stated activity (the actor enters or submits information), and the description then continues with further work

rules.instruction: When the description states that, after a main activity has started, the process keeps running for an extended period in which one party repeatedly receives several separately named kinds of communication from another party, such as regular updates, improvements or renewal notices: Model each separately named communication as its own task performed by the sending party, using the description's wording for that communication, and do not merge them into one generic notification task. Place these tasks inside the ongoing period, for example in a loop or on a repeating branch that returns to the point where the period is waiting for the next event. Keep the period's continuation and its exit path explicit with gateways, so that the communications are not omitted or left outside the ongoing phase.
rules.situation: the description states that, after a main activity has started, the process keeps running for an extended period in which one party repeatedly receives several separately named kinds of communication from another party, such as regular updates, improvements or renewal notices
